_doc: Capture the Flag (2v2 to 4v4): take the other side's flag from its base and bring it to yours while your own is home. Touching a flag (within pickup_radius plus your body) takes it, or sends your own dropped flag home; a carrier is slowed (carry_slow) and drops it where it goes down; a dropped flag goes home by itself after return_seconds. First to captures_to_win, or more at time; a tie at time is sudden death. The `defenders` fighters after a side's first slot (a human's, in a match against the CPU) guard the base. Unlimited lives (respawns at your end like Team Deathmatch); KOs score nothing. Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds. Hard hits on the carrier (launched, knocked down, guard broken, swallowed) knock the flag loose (fumble: it pops fumble_pop px the way they were hit; they can't touch it for fumble_lock ticks). TAG while carrying passes it to the teammate you aim at (pass_range, pass_cone, pass_speed px a tick); a flag in the air can be caught from catch_from of its flight: by the thrower's side it's carried on, by its own side it goes home. Comebacks: respawn_seconds_flag_away while your own flag is away; overtime_carry_slow in sudden death. capture_slowmo: ticks of slow motion on a capture. shrines: the map's shrines, claimed by a side alone in one for claim_seconds, give its fighters haste (haste_mult walking) or might (might_mult damage) for buff_seconds, then rest for cooldown_seconds (first ready after first_seconds). class_perks: per fighter class (its sheet's role), what it adds here (carry_slow, steady, knock, pass, claim, reach; see TeamSim) and the text the game shows.

assassin.text: carries the flag almost at full speed

tank.text: only launches and knockdowns knock the flag loose

bruiser.text: any heavy hit knocks the flag out of a carrier

fighter.text: grabs and returns flags from farther
